rationale: Budget cut to 205,000 USD: the expedite plans (209,731 USD and up) are out. The time-optimal plan must stay within budget and so has at most 8 days of minimum slack (base: 15.05), but the cheap one-departure-earlier plan (about 200,331 USD) still reaches an on-time probability above 0.99.
falsifier: Refuted if the time-optimal plan exceeds 205,000 USD, has more than 8 days of slack, or if the risk-adjusted plan is on time with probability 0.99 or lower.
